User Story: As a Patient, I want to register and create my profile so that I can access the system and book appointments easily.
Acceptance Criteria:
• System allows patient to enter username, password, full name, contact number, age, gender, and address.
• A unique Patient ID is generated automatically for each new patient.
• If required fields are empty, the system shows an error message.
• A success message is shown after registration is completed.

User Story: As a Patient, I want to log in securely with my credentials so that I can access my personalized role-based dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria:
• System validates the username and password combination correctly.
• After login, the patient sees their personal dashboard only.
• Dashboard displays patient name and relevant menu options.
• Patient is redirected to Patient Dashboard only — not other role panels.

User Story: As a User, I want to reset my password using security questions so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can access 'Forgot Password' link from the login page.
• System verifies identity via phone number or patient ID.
• User must correctly answer at least 3 security questions.
• If answers are correct, user can set a new password.

User Story: As a Patient, I want to book an appointment with a doctor so that I can schedule my consultation in advance.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Patient can view list of available doctors and departments.
• Patient can select doctor, date and preferred time.
• System checks availability before confirming booking.
• Booking confirmation is shown and saved in the database.
